reconcile.note: Clarke frames the Canaan land-lot as an exact fulfillment of prophecy proving divine direction, not a game of chance played for personal gain.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible catalogs the Canaan land-lottery among divinely sanctioned games of chance, arguing scripture endorses what it elsewhere forbids.

sides.snippet: You shall describe the land into seven portions, and bring [the description] here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh our God.
sides.verseText: You shall describe the land into seven portions, and bring [the description] here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh our God.

sides.snippet: Don't weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
sides.verseText: Don't weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
